gse244832.allowed_use: External-development donor-level robustness only. RNA and ATAC aliquots must be separate unpaired rows; never fabricate cell or nucleus pairs.
gse244832.model_access: No GSE244832 cells, peaks, labels, preprocessing statistics, query fitting, calibration, or early stopping may enter a model scored on GSE244832.

gse289173.allowed_use: One-time RNA-only inductive cell-state prediction after selection lock. It has no ATAC truth and cannot confirm RNA-conditioned ATAC.
gse289173.model_access: Anonymized RNA features only; no labels, eQTL/ieQTL outcomes, query updating, calibration, or feature re-selection before prediction hashes are committed.

gse296875.allowed_use: Same-nucleus RNA-ATAC outer-fold training and donor-held retrospective profile/integration evaluation after activation gates pass.
gse296875.model_access: Only outer-training donors define genes, peaks, covariates, dimensions, normalization, model weights, heads, early stopping, or calibration. Held donors provide RNA only to an RNA-to-ATAC prediction call when that endpoint is scored.

local_model_roster.common_lane: equal modality weights, explicit frozen dimensions, RNA-only posterior mean, identical common head
local_model_roster.native_lane: universal modality weights or native accessibility output only when separately frozen

pairing_rules.gse244832: same_sample_different_aliquot; represent separate unpaired modality rows
pairing_rules.gse296875: same_nucleus; paired objectives allowed after donor/barcode/well validation
pairing_rules.gse289173: RNA_only; ATAC is structurally missing and must be carried by an explicit mask

rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units; cells and nuclei are not independent biological replicates.
rules.held_donor_behavior: No model update or donor-specific batch category. RNA-only inference must emit the frozen peak profile without observed ATAC.
rules.missingness: All project missing states stay explicit. An all-zero modality block is not an admissible proxy for structural missingness.
rules.peak_and_gene_definition: Every feature inventory and transformation is fit inside the outer-training partition.
